snippet.title: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime - Voice Cast Reveal! incl. Ludwig, CDAWGVA, Lilypichu, IronMouse & more
snippet.description:
Bonnie’s self-worth is at an all-time low, and there’s only one thing that can fix it - a lovely game of Frogtime! Grab your toadbag and get ready to go on a hilarious adventure full of quirky characters, explorable islands, and way too many frogs. Collect dozens of customizable frogs with unique abilities Master the tactical turn-based game of Frogtime Encounter weird friends, weirder enemies, and a talking baby goblin Fully voice acted, featuring endearing recorded mishaps and a bunch of guest voice actors 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2466130/Bonnie_Bear_Saves_Frogtime/
